| description = Spawns at loc 1556.89, -2381.59, -99.69 in the caves at a dead end. 

Shares a spawn cycle with [[a minotaur slaver]]s (with an "a", 3 spawns in the mines). If no Lord is up, one will spawn on the first available a minotaur slaver (with an "a") spawn inside the mines. If a Lord is up anywhere else in the mines, a minotaur slaver (with an "a") will spawn on his spot.

When attacked: "Minotaur Lord says, 'I survived the gladiator pens of Qeynos!! What can you do to one such as I?!!'"

Can spawn the [[Minotaur Hero]] when killed.
